text:
Sophie - New Hire: Morning! Got my Mac (M2) and during setup the company SSO webview kept timing out so enrollment didn't finish. Now System Settings shows 'MDM enrollment: pending' and FileVault is greyed out. Also prompted for 'Approve sign-in request' in Okta but nothing shows on my phone. Who should I ping? :wave:
Theo (IT): Welcome Sophie! If the Okta sign-in didn't complete the DEP flow can hang. Try opening https://okta.redwood.com on your phone and approving any pending push. If that fails, DM me serial and we'll attempt a remote re-enroll.
Sophie - New Hire: Did that, approved the push, but webview still errors with "network error". Serial is Z3X4C5V6B7N8.
IT Bot: Created ticket ONB-5902 assigned to eng-infra. ETA 2 hours.
Marek - EngInfra: Hey Sophie — can you run these and paste outputs?```bash
system_profiler SPHardwareDataType | grep Serial
profiles status -type enrollment
sudo log show --predicate 'process == "mdmclient"' --last 5m | tail -n 40
```
Sophie - New Hire: Pasting outputs:```
Serial: Z3X4C5V6B7N8
profiles: No enrolled profiles
mdmclient: https error 0x6d
mdmclient: token validation failed: 403
```
Theo (IT): 403/token validation suggests the Okta/OAuth token expired during the flow. Marek, can you check APNS/Jamf side?
Marek - EngInfra: Looks like Jamf rejected the registration because the device name had an unexpected character from the setup (emoji?). I can kick a re-enroll for that serial. In the short term, do you need admin rights to finish dev setup?
Sophie - New Hire: Yeah need sudo to install Docker & Homebrew before standup.
Lina (People Ops): We can approve a temporary admin session, but we need manager approval in-thread. Jordan — can you confirm?
Jordan (Manager): Confirmed, I approve temporary admin for Sophie for 5 hours.
Lina (People Ops): Done — temporary admin granted to sophie@redwood.com, expires in 5h. Check System Settings -> Users & Groups after a logout/login.
Sophie - New Hire: I see the admin flag now. Able to run `sudo` and install Homebrew. Thanks!
Marek - EngInfra: Re-enroll pushed. If you get a Remote Management prompt accept it. If webview still fails, run this diagnostic and paste results:```bash
sudo profiles renew -type enrollment && sudo jamf enroll -promptNo
```(if jamf present)
Sophie - New Hire: Rebooted, didn't get Remote Management prompt. Ran `profiles renew`, got `profiles: No enrolled profiles`.
Marek - EngInfra: Hmm. Can you check network (VPN/captive portal)? Sometimes company wifi blocks the callback ports. Try tethering to your phone or join a different network and then reboot.
Sophie - New Hire: Switched to phone hotspot and rebooted. Now I got a "Remote Management" prompt and accepted. `profiles status` shows MDM profile.
IT Bot: ONB-5902 updated: Re-enroll succeeded after network change; profile applied.
Marek - EngInfra: Great. Pushing FileVault enable profile now. Note: because of our KMS/HSM policy, FileVault enablement will escrow the key to the corporate KMS. This can sometimes trigger an additional Okta MFA prompt — we pushed the MFA in-band to your phone during the flow.
Sophie - New Hire: I saw an Okta push and accepted. FileVault now shows "Enabling" after restart.
Jordan (Manager): Thanks team. Once FileVault is on please revoke the temp admin.
Lina (People Ops): Will auto-revoke at expiry, but I'll manually revoke once FileVault reports complete.
Sophie - New Hire: Docker and VS Code installed, dev env mostly up. One leftover: when I tried `ssh-add ~/.ssh/id_ed25519` it refused: "Could not open a connection to your authentication agent." Any quick tip?
Marek - EngInfra: Run `eval $(ssh-agent -s)` then `ssh-add ~/.ssh/id_ed25519`. If you want the agent to persist across restarts, follow the dotfiles guide in the handbook.
Sophie - New Hire: That worked. FileVault finished enabling after restart and I no longer see admin tag. All good! :rocket:
IT Bot: ONB-5902 resolved: Jamf re-enroll completed; FileVault enabled and recovery key escrowed; temporary admin revoked. If further issues, reopen the ticket or DM eng-infra.
Sophie - New Hire: Huge thanks everyone, excited to start. :tada:
